input.code:
def process(pleasureBay) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd
    import numpy as np

    df = pleasureBay.copy()

    # Identify columns: 1-day rainfall just prior to sampling and Pleasure Bay Beach enterococcus.
    # After skiprows=2 the expected headers are:
    # Date, Rainfall (inches) during 3-day period before sampling,
    # Rainfall (inches) during 2-day period before sampling,
    # Rainfall (inches) during 1-day period before sampling,
    # Tag, Pleasure Bay @ Broadway, Tag.1, Pleasure Bay @ Flagpole, Tag.2, Castle Island Playground
    date_col = df.columns[0]
    rain1_col = [c for c in df.columns if "1-day" in c][0]
    broadway_col = "Pleasure Bay @ Broadway"

    # Keep rows where we have an enterococcus value for Pleasure Bay @ Broadway.
    sub = df[[date_col, rain1_col, broadway_col]].copy()
    sub = sub.dropna(subset=[broadway_col])

    # Parse enterococcus values; treat values like '< 2' as numeric 2 for pass/fail thresholding.
    ent_raw = sub[broadway_col].astype(str).str.strip()
    ent_num = (
        ent_raw.str.replace(",", "", regex=False)
        .str.replace(r"^<\s*", "", regex=True)
    )
    ent_num = pd.to_numeric(ent_num, errors="coerce")

    # Parse 1-day rainfall.
    rain1 = pd.to_numeric(sub[rain1_col].astype(str).str.strip(), errors="coerce")

    failed = ent_num > 104

    avg_rain1_failed = float(rain1[failed].mean())

    out = pd.DataFrame(
        [{
            "n_failed": int(failed.sum()),
            "avg_rain1_failed": avg_rain1_failed,
        }]
    )
    return out
